topic: Reviewing impression and dwell time calculations
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on reviewing the calculation methods for impressions and dwell time. Initial test calculations with varying radii were deemed acceptable, but a discrepancy was noted regarding how dwell time was calculated versus internal methodology.

It was determined that implementing changes based on a full recalculation of sessions (as proposed in an existing ticket) would significantly alter the data and was therefore rejected. Instead, new impressions should be calculated without making such a change to dwell time.

Additionally, someone noted that the current average screen seen metric appears very small and requires re-verification.
decisions: New impression calculations will proceed without implementing changes based on full session recalculation for dwell time.
action_items: Re-verify the 'average screen seen' metric due to concerns about its size.
